headline: Jorge Messi, father of soccer legend Lionel Messi, passes away at 68
summary: The Argentine footballer's father died Friday night at a clinic in Rosario after a long illness, his family confirmed.
details: Jorge Messi passed away on Friday night at the age of 68 at a medical clinic in Rosario, Argentina, following a long illness.
The family confirmed that Jorge spent his final months alternating between a medical center in Rosario and his home, supported by his wife and children.
Jorge was a crucial pillar of support for Lionel throughout his career, serving as his representative and accompanying him from his early days at Barcelona.
Lionel Messi had previously expressed how much he valued his father's approval, stating that he would ask for his opinion after every match since childhood.
During the World Cup, Messi's emotional state was linked to his father's health, as he had previously mentioned going through difficult days unrelated to football.
caption:
A pillar of support for one of the greatest players in history. Jorge Messi has passed away at 68.

Jorge Messi passed away on Friday night at the age of 68 at a medical clinic in Rosario, Argentina, following a long illness.

The family confirmed that Jorge spent his final months alternating between a medical center in Rosario and his home, supported by his wife and children.

Jorge was a crucial pillar of support for Lionel throughout his career, serving as his representative and accompanying him from his early days at Barcelona.

Lionel Messi had previously expressed how much he valued his father's approval, stating that he would ask for his opinion after every match since childhood.

During the World Cup, Messi's emotional state was linked to his father's health, as he had previously mentioned going through difficult days unrelated to football.

headline: 867 dead as measles outbreak kills 4 more in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in both confirmed and suspected measles cases across Bangladesh.
details: Four more patients died from measles and measles-like symptoms in the 24 hours until 8:00am today, raising the country’s combined tally of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 867 this year.
According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), two of the deaths were confirmed as measles-related, while the other two were classified as suspected deaths.
The total number of confirmed measles deaths has now risen to 98, while suspected deaths stand at 769.
In the same 24-hour period, 677 new suspected measles cases were reported, bringing the cumulative number of suspected cases nationwide to 135,332.
Additionally, 99 new confirmed measles cases were recorded, bringing the total number of laboratory-confirmed infections to 17,040.
Since March 15 this year, a total of 117,444 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalised across the country, of whom 113,200 have recovered.
caption:
867 deaths this year. 4 more died in just 24 hours as the measles outbreak worsens.

Four more patients died from measles and measles-like symptoms in the 24 hours until 8:00am today, raising the country’s combined tally of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 867 this year.

According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), two of the deaths were confirmed as measles-related, while the other two were classified as suspected deaths.

The total number of confirmed measles deaths has now risen to 98, while suspected deaths stand at 769.

In the same 24-hour period, 677 new suspected measles cases were reported, bringing the cumulative number of suspected cases nationwide to 135,332.

Additionally, 99 new confirmed measles cases were recorded, bringing the total number of laboratory-confirmed infections to 17,040.

Since March 15 this year, a total of 117,444 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalised across the country, of whom 113,200 have recovered.
